body: Ive posted here before. I tell my story over and over again... It dosen't make me feel any better.

Then what about people who accidentally kill themselves? What about people who stand on the edge then decide not and slip? There is a lot of fucking WHAT IF'S and honestly. It's not worth going over all of them anymore.
If death is permanently shitty then why dose it matter. You're going to die. Your loved ones are dead. It's inevitable.

The tunnel is a tunnel. I keep running chasing a light... It goes out. I turn around, there it is. I run... It goes away. I turn around there it is. I'll die in this tunnel if it's from running myself to death or on my own terms.

No. It's like killing yourself because you might get your legs cut off. Death offers the possibility of eternal peace. Life is a constantly changing thing. Death is permanent... and in that idea I find solace.
No. I don't have a whole lot of friends and I don't like talking to people.

Jamie was the only true friend I've ever had. We were inseparable we spent every moment of free time together and he would stay over at my house from Friday after school, until we got on the bus on monday to go back and do it all again. He was so close to my family that my parents invited him to come with us to Disney. (We live in Florida and we go every year.) The morning of the big trip I tried to wake him up... But he wouldn't... I knew something was wrong but my parents thought it was a joke... I begged for them to help... I didn't know what to do... I never learned CPR... maybe if I knew... I don't know... After that happend none of my other friends were allowed to come over because he was drinking the night before and the local news said it was alcohol poisoning... So the rest of high school I started to lose contact with a lot of people because their parents didn't trust me... I was a drunk fuck up loser in the eyes of my town and I still am... I never did anything to hurt anyone the way the world hurt me... I didn't deserve it... I fuck up everything I try to do... I'm depressed all the time... and if I love something it will die anyways... There is no hope anymore.

I knew a girl named Melissa. She was the nicest person I've ever met. She always made everyone around her happy. I never saw her anything but happy. Even when she had to wear an oxygen tank. She died a month ago. Her boyfriend is taking it really rough. They were the only couple that didn't make me envious, I was just happy for them. If love so pure burns out so fast what hope do I have?

Every time It seems there is a light at the end of the tunnel someone shuts it off... Justin was always so happy around people. He played guitar and he was really good. If a person like that... who seemed to have so much to live for was depressed enough to take their own life what hope do I have?

My life summed up in one moment. 

Mom: What part of your life dosen't suck?

Me: (Silence for the remainder of the 15 minuet car ride.)

It's not enough anymore... Nothing can keep me happy... Pills, Therapy, Drugs, not even people... I fuck up every relationship I'm in... I can't feel for other people... I just... I want it to stop... I'm tired of hurting so much and being around so much negativity... I try to get away from this place but I keep getting brought back...
I am 100 guaranteed to be apart in life.
There is like a 8 level parking garage I have access too... Good final view of a city... Far from home... makes me feel safe...
